record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Bless<WH01288><WTH8761> the LORD<WH03068>, O my soul<WH05315>: and all that is within<WH07130> me, <FI>bless<Fi> his holy<WH06944> name<WH08034>.

<FI> As for<Fi> man<WH0582>, his days<WH03117> <FI>are<Fi> as grass<WH02682>: as a flower<WH06731> of the field<WH07704>, so he flourisheth<WH06692><WTH8686>.
